post.description: Runs in the background: poll `listStorageTrims` (or the `trims` of `getProjectStorage`) until the trim is gone. Deletes requests, jobs, logs, error occurrences, runtime and custom metrics and profiles before the cutoff day; rollups (charts and stats) and error groups keep their own retention. A pending trim of the same target is reused and moved to the later cutoff. Deleted rows free their space for reuse by new telemetry right away; the VACUUM run after each partition gives only the empty pages at its end back to the OS, so the database shrinks partly until the partitions age out of RETENTION_DAYS.
post.summary: Delete the raw telemetry of a project or one application older than the last `keepDays` days
